column2:
Here are my rough notes from a meeting I just had with [who you met with] about [topic]:
[Paste your raw, messy meeting notes here]
Turn this into a clean meeting summary email I can send to all attendees. Include: (1) a 2-3 sentence overview of what was discussed, (2) key decisions made, (3) action items with the person responsible and deadline for each, and (4) next meeting date/time if applicable. Format it so it's scannable — bullet points, bold names on action items.

I need to figure out the right pricing for [your product/service]. Here's my situation:
- What I sell: [describe]
- Current price: [your current price, or "haven't priced it yet"]
- Target customer: [describe, including their budget sensitivity]
- Competitors charge: [list what you know about competitor pricing]
- My costs/margins: [what it costs you to deliver]
- My positioning: [premium / mid-market / budget / value]
Analyze: (1) Where my pricing sits relative to market, (2) Whether I'm likely underpriced or overpriced and why, (3) 3 pricing models I should consider (e.g., project-based, retainer, tiered, value-based, hourly), (4) Pros and cons of each model for my business type, (5) A recommended pricing structure with specific numbers, (6) How to test and validate the new pricing. Be direct — if I'm undercharging, tell me.
